scholarships.name: QC Youth Development Office (QCYDO) - Academic / Economic Assistance
scholarships.eligibility: Quezon City resident college students with a certain GWA threshold or belonging to low-income families
scholarships.requirements: QC resident for at least 3 years, enrolled in any CHED-recognized program, good moral character, proof of income or GWA
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Usually July-August for 1st sem, December-January for 2nd sem
scholarships.verificationSource: Quezon City Government QCYDO official social media and announcements
scholarships.applicantNotes: One of the most accessible LGU stipends in NCR. Strictly for QC residents.

scholarships.name: QC Youth Development Office (QCYDO) - Athlete / Arts and Culture
scholarships.eligibility: Quezon City resident college students who are recognized athletes or active cultural/arts performers
scholarships.requirements: QC resident, must provide proof of athletic achievement (e.g., UAAP, NCAA, local meets) or cultural group affiliation/performance
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Usually July-August for 1st sem, December-January for 2nd sem
scholarships.verificationSource: Quezon City Government QCYDO official social media and announcements
scholarships.applicantNotes: Higher stipend tier compared to the academic/economic category due to training and competition demands.

scholarships.name: QC Youth Development Office (QCYDO) - Persons with Disability (PWD) / Solo Parent
scholarships.eligibility: QC resident college students who are registered PWDs or Solo Parents
scholarships.requirements: QC resident, valid PWD ID or Solo Parent ID from QC Social Services Development Department (SSDD)
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Usually July-August for 1st sem, December-January for 2nd sem
scholarships.verificationSource: Quezon City Government QCYDO official social media and announcements
scholarships.applicantNotes: Inclusive education support category. Can sometimes be combined with other CHED subsidies depending on guidelines.

scholarships.name: STI Academic Merit Discount (All Campuses)
scholarships.eligibility: Incoming SHS or College students with high grades from previous school
scholarships.requirements: Form 138/Report card with corresponding GWA, must enroll in any STI campus
scholarships.verificationSource: STI College official enrollment guidelines and student handbooks
scholarships.applicantNotes: Automatically applied upon submission of valid credentials during enrollment. Not a full scholarship (does not cover fees).

scholarships.name: AMA Computer College Academic Scholarship (Grade-Based)
scholarships.eligibility: College freshmen and continuing students with high academic standing
scholarships.requirements: Report card or transcript of records with required GWA
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Upon enrollment or before each semester
scholarships.applicantNotes: Strictly grade-based. Must maintain GWA to retain the discount in subsequent semesters.

scholarships.name: Arellano University Academic Scholarship (Valedictorian/Salutatorian/HM)
scholarships.eligibility: High school graduates with specific academic ranks
scholarships.requirements: Certificate of recognition from high school proving rank in a class of at least 50 students
scholarships.applicantNotes: Class rank must be from the immediately preceding school year. Must maintain a required GWA to renew.

scholarships.name: National University Academic Merit Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Incoming college freshmen from partner high schools or with exceptional academic records
scholarships.benefits: 100% tuition and fees (top tier), partial discounts (lower tiers)
scholarships.requirements: High GWA, pass NU placement exam, meet specific tier criteria
scholarships.verificationSource: National University Admissions and Scholarships page
scholarships.applicantNotes: Under SM Group ownership, NU has heavily funded scholarship tiers for top academic performers.

scholarships.name: FEU Academic Scholarship (Valedictorian/Salutatorian)
scholarships.eligibility: High school valedictorians and salutatorians from recognized schools
scholarships.benefits: 100% tuition and fees (Valedictorian), 50% tuition and fees (Salutatorian)
scholarships.requirements: Certificate of rank from high school principal, enrollment in FEU Manila or FEU Tech
scholarships.applicantNotes: Highly competitive. Must maintain a specific GWA per semester to retain the scholarship.

scholarships.name: LPU Academic Discount (Grade-Based)
scholarships.eligibility: Incoming and continuing LPU students
scholarships.requirements: Form 138 or TOR reflecting the required GWA
scholarships.verificationSource: LPU Student Handbook and Finance Office guidelines
scholarships.applicantNotes: Standardized grade-based discount system across LPU campuses.

scholarships.name: PUP Entrance Scholarship (Top PUPCET Passers)
scholarships.eligibility: Top scorers in the PUP College Entrance Test (PUPCET) per program/campus
scholarships.benefits: Free tuition and miscellaneous fees for one semester (renewable)
scholarships.requirements: Top PUPCET rank in chosen program
scholarships.verificationSource: PUP Office of Scholarships and Student Services
scholarships.applicantNotes: Renewable if the student maintains a required GWA (usually 1.25 or better for full scholarship).

scholarships.name: EA Trishield Gaming Scholarship (via partner schools)
scholarships.eligibility: College students in game development, programming, or esports management
scholarships.requirements: Enrolled in relevant program, competitive gaming portfolio or academic standing
scholarships.applicantNotes: Niche scholarship. Verify current availability with partner schools' gaming/esports departments.

scholarships.name: Rodriguez (Montalban) Municipal Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Residents of Rodriguez, Rizal
scholarships.requirements: Rodriguez resident, good academic standing
scholarships.applicantNotes: Apply at the municipal social welfare office.

scholarships.name: Binangonan Municipal Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Residents of Binangonan, Rizal
scholarships.requirements: Binangonan resident, good academic standing
scholarships.applicantNotes: Coordinate with MSWDO Binangonan.

scholarships.name: Angono Municipal Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Residents of Angono, Rizal
scholarships.requirements: Angono resident, good academic standing
scholarships.applicantNotes: Angono is the 'Art Capital of the Philippines'; some scholarship tiers may favor arts students.

scholarships.name: Marilao Municipal Scholarship (Bulacan)
scholarships.eligibility: Residents of Marilao, Bulacan
scholarships.requirements: Marilao resident, good academic standing
scholarships.applicantNotes: Apply at the MSWDO.

scholarships.name: Santa Maria Municipal Scholarship (Bulacan)
scholarships.eligibility: Residents of Santa Maria, Bulacan
scholarships.requirements: Santa Maria resident, good academic standing
scholarships.verificationSource: Santa Maria Bulacan Municipal Government page
scholarships.applicantNotes: Santa Maria is a fast-growing municipality with many local colleges.

scholarships.name: Guiguinto Municipal Scholarship (Bulacan)
scholarships.eligibility: Residents of Guiguinto, Bulacan
scholarships.requirements: Guiguinto resident, good academic standing
scholarships.applicantNotes: Apply at the municipal social welfare and development office.

scholarships.name: Carmona Municipal Scholarship (Cavite)
scholarships.eligibility: Residents of Carmona, Cavite
scholarships.requirements: Carmona resident, good academic standing
scholarships.applicantNotes: Carmona is an industrial town; some scholarship slots may be linked to local industrial partners.

scholarships.name: Mexico Municipal Scholarship (Pampanga)
scholarships.eligibility: Residents of Mexico, Pampanga
scholarships.requirements: Mexico Pampanga resident, good academic standing
scholarships.applicantNotes: Apply at the municipal social welfare office.

scholarships.name: San Simon Municipal Scholarship (Pampanga)
scholarships.eligibility: Residents of San Simon, Pampanga
scholarships.requirements: San Simon resident, good academic standing
scholarships.verificationSource: San Simon Pampanga Municipal Government page
scholarships.applicantNotes: San Simon is part of the Pampanga industrial corridor.

scholarships.name: Liliw Municipal Scholarship (Laguna)
scholarships.eligibility: Residents of Liliw, Laguna
scholarships.requirements: Liliw resident, good academic standing
scholarships.applicantNotes: Small municipality; verify if a dedicated college scholarship exists.

scholarships.name: DMCI Holdings Scholarship Program
scholarships.eligibility: Children of DMCI employees and selected external applicants in engineering
scholarships.requirements: Engineering student, good academic standing
scholarships.applicantNotes: Strong focus on civil, mining, and mechanical engineering aligned with DMCI businesses.

scholarships.name: AC Energy Scholarship (Renewable Energy Focus)
scholarships.eligibility: Engineering students specializing in electrical, mechanical, or energy engineering
scholarships.benefits: Tuition assistance, internship at AC Energy
scholarships.requirements: 3rd or 4th year engineering student, good academic standing
scholarships.applicantNotes: Aligned with the renewable energy transition thrust of AC Energy.
